title: Serverware Controller Receipt Contract v12
description: Closed ReceiptV12 wire contract layered on the canonical controller request v11. FinalSettlementArtifactV12 is also fully defined for durable lookup and settlement verification without creating a receipt digest cycle.

u64.description: Canonical unsigned 64-bit integer encoded as exactly 20 zero-padded decimal digits.

positiveU64.description: Canonical positive unsigned 64-bit integer encoded as exactly 20 zero-padded decimal digits.

keyAuthorization.description: Evidence carried for joining only. Native verification must resolve the same current authorization and revocation state from an independently pinned trust source; this object cannot authorize itself.

trustGenerationBundle.description: Retained signed authorization chain and signed generation. Native verification applies the complete Rust contract and both signature domains before any carried key material is trusted.

lifecycleCleanupEvidence.description: Closed exact-request-bound cleanup record. The request carries host boot identity and CLOCK_BOOTTIME deadline; the response carries complete destruction evidence and canonical response digests.

x-canonical-v12.json: Every object is RFC 8785 canonical JSON encoded as UTF-8. A bounded duplicate-aware streaming preflight rejects duplicate keys, floating-point and negative values, unsafe JSON integers above 2^53-1, invalid UTF-8, noncanonical numbers, excess nesting, excess members, excess strings, trailing bytes, and inputs larger than the operation-specific bound before object allocation. All counters and lengths other than literal contractVersion use D20 strings.
x-canonical-v12.clientArtifact: The schema root remains ReceiptV12 for controller wire compatibility. The closed finalSettlementArtifact definition is used by durable lookup and settlement verification. It is non-cyclic: the artifact may carry one ReceiptV12, while ReceiptV12 never embeds the settlement artifact. finalSettlementArtifactSha256 = H12('final-settlement-artifact',JCS(finalSettlementArtifact)) is an external lookup and commit binding and is intentionally not embedded in the artifact itself.
x-canonical-v12.requestV11: requestAdmission retains the exact 256-byte canonical preallocation frame, exact canonical request v11 bytes, and a controller-ingress signature over trusted receive time, CLOCK_BOOTTIME observation, absolute request deadline, frame and request digests and limits, current requester authorization and revocation high-water, verifier profile, full relationship profile, and controller configuration. Native verification invokes the canonical v11 frame decoder and request verifier and never creates a fresh requestedAt for an expired request. requestAdmissionSha256 = H12('canonical-request-admission-v11',JCS(requestAdmission)).
x-canonical-v12.digest: H12(tag,parts...) = SHA-256(UTF8('serverware/controller/v12/') || U64BE(LEN(tag)) || UTF8(tag) || each U64BE(LEN(part)) || part). JSON parts are exact RFC 8785 bytes. Hex digest fields decode to exactly 32 bytes before entering a preimage.
x-canonical-v12.signature: A v12 signature signs H12('signature-message',UTF8(domain),HEX(payloadSha256),UTF8(signedAt),UTF8(acceptedAt),UTF8(signerRole),UTF8(signerPrincipalId),UTF8(signerKeyId),HEX(signerSpkiDerSha256),HEX(keyAuthorization.keyAuthorizationSha256)). The signature's domain, role, principal, key, SPKI, authorization, validity, revocation, and high-water must equal an independently resolved current pin; carried authorization is join evidence only.
x-canonical-v12.typedEnvelope: payloadSha256 = H12('payload',UTF8(domain),JCS(payload)). envelopeSha256 = H12('typed-envelope',UTF8(domain),HEX(payloadSha256),JCS(signature)). receiptAuthenticationEnvelopeSha256, signedTreeHeadEnvelopeSha256, externalWitnessCheckpointEnvelopeSha256, finalVerdictEnvelopeSha256, authorizationChainEnvelopeSha256, generationEnvelopeSha256, and finalSettlementCheckpointEnvelopeSha256 use this sole formula.
x-canonical-v12.receiptBody: receiptBodySha256 = H12('receipt-body',JCS(receiptBody)); receiptBodyCanonicalBytes is its exact canonical byte length. Root, body, authentication, log leaf, final trust, and final verdict fields named receiptId, receiptSequence, replayKeySha256, requestV11Sha256, requestEnvelopeSha256, requestCanonicalBytes, terminalEvidenceRootSha256, terminalStateRootSha256, bodyTrustObservationSha256, receiptBodySha256, and receiptBodyCanonicalBytes agree byte-for-byte wherever present.
x-canonical-v12.replay: replayKeySha256 = H12('replay-identity',UTF8(replayNamespace),UTF8(replayKey)). A replay key permanently identifies one prepared binding. An exact retry returns the byte-for-byte stored artifact for its settled stage; any changed request, body, terminal root, trust observation, verdict, witness checkpoint, or finalization input is a conflict.
x-canonical-v12.log: leafSha256 = H12('pre-final-log-leaf',JCS(preFinalLogLeaf with leafSha256 replaced by 64 ASCII zeroes)). The log uses RFC 6962 shape without duplicate-last: leaf node H12('merkle-leaf',UTF8(treeDomain),HEX(leafSha256)); internal node H12('merkle-node',UTF8(treeDomain),HEX(left),HEX(right)); empty root H12('merkle-empty',UTF8(treeDomain)). Inclusion and consistency proofs are verified against the exact signed head. A non-genesis head names the immediately preceding signed head and proves append-only extension; genesis uses the fixed empty root and zero tree size.
x-canonical-v12.witness: The external witness checkpoint signs the exact signed-tree-head envelope digest, tree size, root, witness sequence, and predecessor witness checkpoint. The witness key, log, rollback high-water, and current revocation state come from independent verifier pins, never from the receipt.
x-canonical-v12.finalTrust: finalTrustObservationSha256 = H12('final-trust-observation',JCS(finalTrustObservation)). Each finalization retains a trust-root-authorized signed generation, its predecessor and rollback floor, and exact requester, controller-ingress, receipt-authentication, receipt-log, external-witness, final-verdict, and final-settlement material. Historical exact-byte retries use that retained chain; fresh finalizations must also match independently resolved current policy and monotonic authorization and revocation high-water.
x-canonical-v12.finalSettlement: The final-settlement checkpoint signs outcome, receipt or terminal-abort binding, predecessor settlement checkpoint, exact log head and witness checkpoint, and retained trust generation. The checkpoint envelope digest is carried beside the checkpoint; no settlement or artifact digest is embedded in its own preimage. RECEIPT requires a receipt and no terminalAbortReason; TERMINAL_ABORT requires a reason and no receipt; GENESIS carries neither.
x-canonical-v12.bootIdentity: trustedReceivePayload.bootIdSha256 and every authorityDeadline or lifecycleCleanupRequest bootIdSha256 bind CLOCK_BOOTTIME values to one kernel boot. Native verification rejects persisted deadlines or cleanup requests whose boot identity differs from the current host boot.
x-canonical-v12.cleanup: lifecycleCleanupEvidence is a closed auxiliary evidence shape for the controller-v12 lifecycle contract. Its request binds invocation, request, idempotency key, host boot, and cleanup deadline; its response binds complete destruction evidence and canonical response digests. The current FinalSettlementArtifactV12 Rust type does not embed this object, so cleanup is committed indirectly through terminal evidence and state roots.
x-canonical-v12.loggedBundle: loggedBundleSha256 = H12('logged-receipt-bundle',JCS(loggedBundle)). This pre-witness durable bundle digest is distinct from ReceiptV12.logBundleSha256.
x-canonical-v12.receiptEnvelope: receiptEnvelopeSha256 = H12('receipt-envelope',UTF8('12'),UTF8('11'),UTF8(receiptId),D20(receiptSequence),UTF8(requesterPrincipalId),HEX(replayIdentity.replayKeySha256),HEX(requestV11Sha256),HEX(requestEnvelopeSha256),D20(requestCanonicalBytes),HEX(requestAdmissionSha256),HEX(receiptBodySha256),D20(receiptBodyCanonicalBytes),HEX(receiptAuthenticationEnvelopeSha256),HEX(signedTreeHeadEnvelopeSha256),HEX(externalWitnessCheckpointEnvelopeSha256),HEX(logBundleSha256),HEX(finalTrustObservation.trustGenerationEnvelopeSha256),HEX(finalTrustObservationSha256),HEX(finalVerdictEnvelopeSha256)). receiptCanonicalBytes is the exact canonical root length after replacing only receiptEnvelopeSha256 with 64 ASCII zeroes and receiptCanonicalBytes with 20 ASCII zeroes.

x-mandatory-external-trust-inputs-v12.requestVerifier: A separately versioned strict v11 request verifier and immutable v11 request-schema digest.
x-mandatory-external-trust-inputs-v12.authorityPins: Current independently resolved authorization, SPKI, validity, revocation, physical-custody, and high-water pins for controller ingress, receipt authentication, receipt logging, external witnessing, final verdict, trust root, trust generation, and final settlement.
x-mandatory-external-trust-inputs-v12.separation: Receipt-authentication and final-verdict private keys are held by separate processes, UIDs, credentials, and ideally separate HSM or TPM slots. Neither authority maps the other's private key.
x-mandatory-external-trust-inputs-v12.witness: An independently operated append-only witness with rollback-resistant high-water. A co-located witness must be reported as co-located and does not establish fault-domain independence.
x-mandatory-external-trust-inputs-v12.ledger: A durable single-writer ledger with FULL-style file and directory synchronization, exact-byte artifact retention, monotonic sequence allocation, startup reconciliation, and external rollback anchoring.
